# Recon Brief

> Recon Brief is an AI-assisted research and intelligence platform designed to help organize research questions, relevant material, findings, evidence, uncertainty, and limitations into structured working outputs for review.

Recon Brief’s public website describes research uses including market research, competitive intelligence, company research, academic research, research studies, and presentation preparation. The website presents a five-stage conceptual workflow: Define, Research, Evidence, Analyze, and Report. Results and available functionality depend on the current application workflow and the material available for review.

## Public resources

- [Recon Brief homepage](https://www.reconbrief.in/): Evidence-backed research intelligence.
- [About Recon Brief](https://www.reconbrief.in/about): Intended research uses, approach, and audience.
- [How Recon Brief Works](https://www.reconbrief.in/how-it-works): The five-stage research workflow.
- [AI Market Research](https://www.reconbrief.in/ai-market-research): Guidance on market questions, scope, sources, and evidence.
- [Competitor Analysis](https://www.reconbrief.in/competitor-analysis): A five-lens structure for company and competitor research.
- [Research Methodology](https://www.reconbrief.in/research-methodology): The Evidence Review Framework for reviewing research support and limitations.

## Report-depth options

The public homepage describes three illustrative report-depth options: **Quick Answer** for a concise response to a focused question, **Standard Report** for structured coverage of core findings and supporting information, and **Deep Analysis** for broader evidence, comparisons, reasoning, and limitations where available. These descriptions are informational; the current application’s available functionality may vary.
